name: @your-move/worker
description: The Cloudflare runtime: Worker, static assets and (later) Durable Objects

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @your-move/web --filter @your-move/dictionary build && PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8787 tsx scripts/prepare-assets.ts && wrangler dev --config wrangler.example.toml --env-file ../../config/local-dev.env --var PUBLIC_URL:http://localhost:8787 --port 8787
scripts.build: tsx scripts/prepare-assets.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.example.toml --outdir dist/worker --metafile dist/bundle-meta.json && tsx scripts/record-inputs.ts
